item.title: Air Purifiers as White Noise Machines
item.description:
📝 Air Purifiers as White Noise Machines July 29th, 2026 airquality, purifiers White noise machines are widely used for sound masking, increasing privacy in offices and helping people sleep. For most circumstances where someone would use a white noise machine, this kind of small purifier is all-around better. I usually run an AirFanta 3Pro and it cleans ~6x more air for the same amount of noise, or ~12x more air with much more noise (~56dB).
🔗 Read more: https://www.jefftk.com/p/air-purifiers-as-white-noise-machines

item.title: Alzheimer's breakthrough: 2 hrs of sleep restored without clearing brain plaques
item.description:
📝 In experiments involving mice with Alzheimer's-like brain changes, researchers restored more than two hours of sleep per day without removing the amyloid plaques associated with the disease. Rather than simply protecting the brain from damage, these cells can trigger inflammation that interferes with healthy sleep. The brain also contains specialized immune cells known as microglia.
🔗 Read more: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261018084421.htm

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg Pushed Meta to Shield Him from California's Proposed Wealth Tax
Securing our frontier model training environment
item.description:
📝 Loading…ShareThis post describes how we secure the environments that we use to train and evaluate frontier models. These environments allow models to practice these skills, while also restricting what they can access or do—helping contain the consequences when models make mistakes or exhibit misaligned behavior. Teams of frontier-model agents were tasked with finding vulnerabilities and misconfigurations that could allow them to take unauthorized actions—like accessing the live internet, escaping security boundaries, or conducting unauthorized communication with other agents.
🔗 Read more: https://openai.com/index/securing-our-frontier-model-training-environment/
